summary: Callback plugins add behavior in response to events. They control most console output and can also add output, integrate with other tools or send events to storage backends. Custom ones can be written.
questions: What controls the output format of ansible-playbook?
Can Ansible send playbook events to an external system?

answer_card.title: What callback plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Callback plugins react to Ansible events. They produce most of the console output and can also add extra output, integrate with other tools, or ship events to a storage backend. You can write custom ones.
